rules.title: Root file system is not read-only
Default security context configured
rules.resolution: To enhance security, it is strongly recommended not to rely on the default security context. Instead, it is advisable to explicitly define the required security parameters (such as runAsNonRoot, capabilities, readOnlyRootFilesystem, etc.) within the security context.

rules.title: ConfigMap with secrets
rules.resolution: Remove password/secret from configMap data value

rules.title: Exec into Pods
rules.resolution: Remove write permission verbs for resource 'pods/exec'

rules.title: Restrict container images to trusted registries
Seccomp policies disabled
rules.resolution: Specify seccomp either by annotation or by seccomp profile type having allowed values as per pod security standards

rules.title: Image tag ":latest" used
rules.resolution: Use a specific container image tag that is not 'latest'.

rules.title: Prevent binding to privileged ports
rules.resolution: Do not map the container ports to privileged host ports when starting a container.

rules.title: ConfigMap with sensitive content
rules.resolution: Remove sensitive content from configMap data value

rules.title: Manage Kubernetes workloads and pods
rules.resolution: Kubernetes workloads resources are only allowed for verbs 'list', 'watch', 'get'
